headline: Approved abatement of uncollectable back taxes and 22 Leeann St abatement, plus 2026 veterans and solar credits; some veterans credits denied.
summary: Members approved the abatement of uncollectable back taxes, which had been tabled from July 16, 2026. They also approved an administrative abatement for 22 Leeann St for 2024 and 2025. They approved solar exemptions and several veterans credits, and denied other veterans credits.
decisions: Approved the public minutes of the July 16, 2026 meeting, all in favor.
Accepted the non-public minutes of the July 16, 2026 meeting, all in favor.
Approved the abatement of uncollectable back taxes, which had been tabled from July 16, 2026, all in favor.
Approved the administrative abatement for 22 Leeann St for 2024 and 2025, all in favor.
Approved the All Veterans Credit per the list provided (account 11098, 49 New Dunstable Rd), all in favor.
Accepted the late application for the Disabled Veterans Credit at 3 Bartemus Trl, U-206, due to accident, mistake, or misfortune, all in favor.
Approved the Disabled Veterans Credit per the list provided (account 45462, 3 Bartemus Trl, U-206), all in favor.
Denied the Veterans Credit per the list provided (account 36242, 12 Deerhaven Dr), all in favor.
Denied the Disabled Veterans Credits per the list provided (accounts 36242 and 22152), all in favor.
Approved the Solar Exemptions per the list provided (accounts 26732 and 2782), all in favor.
Sealed the minutes of the non-public session, all in favor.
Released the non-public minutes of July 16, 2026 as submitted, all in favor.
